steps: All fans are brown -> some brown are fans (I follows, conversion of A)
Some brown are chairs -> some chairs are brown (II follows)
Some chairs are plastic contradicts III
check_code:
from itertools import product
# regions over sets F(fans), Br(brown), C(chairs), P(plastic): each of 16 regions empty/non-empty
regs=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))
res={1:True,2:True,3:True}
import itertools
for bits in product([0,1],repeat=16):
    S=[r for r,b in zip(regs,bits) if b]
    F=lambda r:r[0]; B=lambda r:r[1]; C=lambda r:r[2]; P=lambda r:r[3]
    if any(F(r) and not B(r) for r in S): continue
    if not any(B(r) and C(r) for r in S): continue
    if not any(C(r) and P(r) for r in S): continue
    if not any(F(r) for r in S): continue  # existential import for fans
    c1=any(B(r) and F(r) for r in S); c2=any(C(r) and B(r) for r in S); c3=not any(C(r) and P(r) for r in S)
    res[1]&=c1; res[2]&=c2; res[3]&=c3
follow=sorted(k for k,v in res.items() if v)
assert follow==[1,2]
opts={"A":[2,3],"B":[3],"C":[],"D":[1,2]}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if v==follow]==["D"]

check_code:
from itertools import product
# sets R(river), M(mountain), A(animal), B(bird)
regs=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))
c1_all=True; c2_all=True
for bits in product([0,1],repeat=16):
    S=[r for r,b in zip(regs,bits) if b]
    if any(r[0] and r[1] for r in S): continue
    if not any(r[0] and r[2] for r in S): continue
    if not any(r[3] and r[1] for r in S): continue
    c1=not any(r[2] and r[1] for r in S); c2=not any(r[0] and r[3] for r in S)
    c1_all&=c1; c2_all&=c2
assert not c1_all and not c2_all
follow=[i for i,v in ((1,c1_all),(2,c2_all)) if v]
opts={"A":[1,2],"B":[],"C":[1],"D":[2]}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if v==follow]==["B"]
